title: Disaster Management
sources_used: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the impact of droughts in India. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html:
• [U] / [CO3] Droughts lead to crop failure, water scarcity, and forced
  • migration, severely affecting rural livelihoods and food security.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Analyse the role of disaster management in protecting the environment. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• [An] / [CO2] Disaster management reduces environmental degradation by
  • promoting sustainable use of natural resources and proactive mitigation
  • planning.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Analyse the importance of integrating disaster management into school/college education. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• [An] / [CO2] Integrating disaster education in schools fosters
  • preparedness, civic responsibility, and long-term resilience against
  • crises.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine the phase Prevention. / [CO2]
questions.solution_html:
• [An] / [CO2] The prevention phase focuses on identifying hazards and
  • implementing structural and non-structural measures to minimize
  • disaster impact.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Define Disaster. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• [U] / [CO1] A disaster is a sudden disruptive event causing widespread
  • human, material, and environmental losses exceeding local coping
  • capacity.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe the social factors that increase disaster risk. / [CO1]
questions.solution_html:
• [U] / [CO1] Social inequality, poverty, and poor governance elevate
  • disaster risk by weakening resilience and adaptive capacity.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Compare vulnerability in urban and rural areas. / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• [An] / [CO5] Urban areas face infrastructure collapse; rural regions
  • experience livelihood disruptions, reflecting different vulnerability
  • dimensions.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine how elderly people face higher vulnerability in disasters. / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• [An] / [CO5] Elderly people face higher vulnerability due to health issues,
  • dependency, and limited mobility during emergencies.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Analyze why the "Call for Help Early" rule is especially important during mass casualty disasters. / [CO5]
questions.solution_html:
• [An] / [CO6] The ‘Call for Help Early’ rule ensures immediate medical
  • response and reduces fatalities in mass casualty situations.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Examine the concept development. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• [An] / [CO4] Development involves structured social and economic
  • progress aiming to enhance quality of life and reduce vulnerability.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Differntiate development and disaster. / [CO4]
questions.solution_html:
• [An] / [CO4] Development and disaster are inversely related—progress
  • builds resilience, while disasters reverse human gains.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Apply sociology of crisis to integrate local knowledge into disaster preparedness. / [CO7]
questions.solution_html:
• [A] / [CO7] Applying local knowledge in crisis management integrates
  • indigenous coping strategies with formal disaster preparedness efforts.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Evaluate the role of civil society in monitoring disaster relief operations. / [CO9]
questions.solution_html:
• [E] / [CO9] Civil society ensures transparency and accountability in
  • disaster relief operations through active participation and oversight.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe risk society. / [CO7]
questions.solution_html:
• [U] / [CO7] Risk society emphasizes global interdependence and human-
  • made risks, reflecting uncertainty in modern industrial systems.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Describe why disaster management builds resilience. / [CO8]
questions.solution_html:
• [U] / [CO8] Disaster management builds resilience by empowering
  • communities to recover, adapt, and rebuild effectively after crises.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Apply public sociology to design a social awareness campaign. / [CO7] [2x13 = 26]
questions.solution_html:
• [A] / [CO7] Public sociology fosters awareness campaigns that mobilize
  • citizens toward proactive disaster risk reduction efforts.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
